canonicalFieldHashes.name: Miso Butter Ramen
canonicalFieldHashes.description: A ten-minute pantry ramen with a glossy miso-butter broth, soft egg, and crisp scallions.
canonicalFieldHashes.recipeIngredient: ["2 packs fresh ramen noodles","3 tbsp white miso paste","2 tbsp unsalted butter","1 tbsp soy sauce","1 tsp toasted sesame oil","750ml hot vegetable stock","2 soft-boiled eggs, halved","3 scallions, thinly sliced","1 sheet nori, torn"]
canonicalFieldHashes.recipeInstructions: [{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Whisk miso, butter, soy and sesame oil into the hot stock until smooth."},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Cook ramen noodles per package instructions, drain, divide between bowls."},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Pour broth over noodles. Top with egg halves, scallions, and nori."},{"@type":"HowToStep","text":"Eat immediately, while the butter is still glossy on the broth."}]
canonicalFieldHashes.author: {"@type":"Person","name":"Kenji Watari"}
